The acceptance test passes ('You won $56', Ah As, Cutoff). Holdout random sessions produced 99 wins, each matching the stack change.

The acceptance test passes. It asserts one replay element with class review-replay, the exact text, a code equal to handRecord's, absence when review is null/closed/entries null, and the CSS font-size comparisons. Holdout: for every fixture and random hand, the replay line text is 'Hand #N · Replay code <code>' and equals handRecord().replayCode. With the panel closed the markup has no code. A ReviewPanel without a summary or with summary null shows no summary and no replay line.

The unit tests pass (the fixture nets, net equal to stack change, the returned amount counted, the resultText cases). Holdout: netResult equals the final stack minus the starting stack for 14 fixtures and 266 random hands. These cover 2, 3, 6, 9 and 10 seats, cash and sit-and-go, and include 26 broke-even hands. resultText(0 and -0) gives 'You broke even'; ±1 and 1500 are worded correctly.
